text: Hotel Figueroa in Los Angeles is currently painting over the iPhone Duo mural, as they potentially prepare for the GTA 6 one next 👀 @RockstarGames 😠
Kaseya Center’s entrance banner has been updated to “Welcome to Vice City” after the HEAT x Rockstar Games announcement. @RockstarGames 😠

French magazine “LOVE” has announced a GTA 6 feature in its upcoming Issue 27, with a new artwork of Jason and Lucia: - The magazine interviewed Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson - Rob Nelson says Rockstar hopes players will want to “escape into these worlds and these characters and get lost with them and in them” - The interview focuses on Rockstar’s approach to world-building, characters, and creating an immersive world where every character feels meaningful - The physical issue will be available October 5 @RockstarGames 😠

Rockstar Games is officially teaming up with the Miami HEAT for a special “Night in Vice City” on November 18 at the Kaseya Center. The HEAT will temporarily rebrand as Vice City and face the Milwaukee Bucks, featuring: - An all-new Vice City uniform - A special hardwood court built for the game - Unique Vice City-themed game-night activations - Special activities inside Kaseya Center starting on opening night A new Vice City collection of apparel is also available on HEAT’s website: http://HEAT.com/ViceCity @RockstarGames 😠
A new look at the fully lit GTA 6 sign in Downtown Miami at night. @RockstarGames 😠
Today marks 13 years since our GTA Online character first arrived in Los Santos. Next month, we finally get to play GTA 6. @RockstarGames 😠
